description: This Kotlin source file defines the InvokeDispatcher class responsible for handling various commands in an Android application, including canvas, camera, location, device, notifications, system, photos, contacts, calendar, motion, SMS, call log, and debug commands. It manages command execution, availability checks, and error handling.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: Main class responsible for dispatching and handling various commands based on input command string and parameters, including availability checks and error handling.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main method that processes a command with optional JSON parameters, dispatching to specific handlers or returning errors for unknown commands.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures A2UI is ready before executing a block of code, handling host URL resolution and reachability.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Executes a block of code with error handling if the canvas is unavailable.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks command availability based on current device and app state, returning appropriate error results if unavailable.
